map.随机分组是做什么的？: What does Team Roster Generator do?
map.如何使用随机分组？: How do I use Team Roster Generator?
map.随机分组适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Team Roster Generator best for?
map.名单先洗牌（Fisher–Yates）后顺序切分；按组数分组时每组人数 = ⌊N: The list is shuffled (Fisher-Yates) then split in order; grouping by group count gives floor(N/G) per group with the remainder N mod G spread across the first groups (e.g. 22 people into 4 groups gives 6/6/5/5); grouping by group size gives ceil(N/M) groups, with the last group holding N - M x (groups-1)
map.先洗牌再切分保证每个成员落入任意组的概率相同，避免\"按输入顺序轮流分配\"造成: Shuffling before splitting gives every member the same probability of landing in any group, avoiding the systematic bias of "assigning round-robin by input order". When the count does not divide evenly the remainder is spread out (rather than dumped into the last group) so group sizes differ by at most 1, which helps competitive activities. The shuffle uses browser pseudo-randomness with no seed, so the same list gives different, non-reproducible results each time; for draws that need a record, export the result before proceeding. Quality constraints (gender/seniority balance, mutually exclusive members) require manual stratification first.

map.粘贴 20 个名字、设 4 组，工具随机均分得到每组 5 人；若需性别/职级均衡: Paste 20 names and set 4 groups; the tool splits them evenly into 5 per group. If you need gender/seniority balance, stratify manually first and group each stratum separately so no group is all one attribute.
map.基于洗牌算法随机均分；如需可复现，记住种子或导出结果即可。特殊约束（如「甲乙不能: It uses a shuffle algorithm for even random splitting; to reproduce it, note the seed or export the result. Special constraints (e.g. two people must not be together) need manual adjustment.
map.人数除不尽怎么办？: What if the headcount does not divide evenly?
map.余数会平摊到前几组（如 22 人分 4 组得 6/6/5/5），工具会标明每组人: The remainder is spread across the first groups (e.g. 22 people into 4 groups gives 6/6/5/5), and the tool labels each group size for easy checking.
